remarks: Experience resort-style living in this beautifully appointed townhome overlooking the River Oaks Golf Course. An impressive two-story foyer with sweeping staircase welcomes you into an open-concept floor plan. The spacious living room features a corner gas fireplace, recessed lighting, custom built-in bookcases, soaring ceilings, and beautiful Brazilian cherry hardwood flooring. The adjacent dining area offers sliding doors leading to an expansive deck with serene golf course views. The well-appointed kitchen features abundant cabinetry, vaulted ceiling, recessed lighting, pantry, breakfast bar, hardwood flooring and a bright dining area surrounded by windows offering so much natural lighting. The first-floor primary suite offers a vaulted ceiling, large walk-in closet, and luxurious ensuite bath with ceramic flooring, whirlpool tub, and separate shower. A convenient first-floor laundry includes ceramic flooring, cabinetry, and a utility tub. Upstairs, you'll find two additional bedrooms, including one with a cathedral ceiling, arched window, and walk-in closet. A full bath and spacious loft overlooking the main living area complete the second floor. Additional features include a full basement, central vacuum, central air conditioning, and an attached two-car garage. Quality construction, thoughtful design, and a sought-after location make this an exceptional opportunity for comfortable upscale living.
